interface.signature: shortestDistance(N, M, X, Y, A) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of rows N must be between 1 and 250.
The number of columns M must be between 1 and 250.
The target row index X must be within the bounds of the matrix.
The target column index Y must be within the bounds of the matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= A[i][j] <= 1 for j in range(M)) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix A must be either 0 or 1.

postconditions.description: If the starting cell (0,0) is 0, the function returns -1.
If the starting cell (0,0) is 1, the function returns a non-negative integer representing the minimum steps.

postconditions.expression: stdout == -1 if not any(A[i][j] == 1 for i in range(N) for j in range(M)) else True
postconditions.description: If there are no valid paths from (0,0) to (X,Y), the function returns -1.
